info.name: AB Testing API
info.description:
This collection provides endpoints for managing A/B testing experiments, including creating, updating, deleting experiments, assigning users to variants, tracking conversion events, and retrieving experiment results. All endpoints use HTTPS and support authentication. The collection is organized into folders by resource and functionality for easy navigation and testing.

---

## Release Notes

### New Endpoint: Create User Segment

A new POST endpoint `{{baseUrl}}/experiments/segments` has been added to allow the creation of user segments for targeting experiments. This endpoint enables you to define custom groups of users based on attributes such as demographics, behavior, or device type. With this feature, experiments can now be targeted to specific audiences rather than the entire user base, providing more granular control and improved experiment accuracy.

**Request body schema:**

```
{
  "demographics": {
    "ageRange": "string",
    "gender": "string",
    "location": "string"
  },
  "behavior": {
    "purchaseHistory": "string",
    "activityLevel": "string"
  },
  "deviceType": "string"
}

 ```

Use this endpoint to create and manage user segments for more effective and personalized experimentation.
